description: Search Pastepile pastes by keyword and get back matching titles, previews, and URLs. With an API key configured this defaults to scope "mine": YOUR private memory, the pastes saved with that key (titles, filenames, and contents, including unlisted pastes). Use scope "public" to search the global public corpus instead. Without a key only the public scope is available.

query.description: Keywords to match against paste titles and content. Required.

scope.description: "mine" searches pastes saved with the configured API key (default when a key is set); "public" searches the public corpus (default without a key).

name: pastepile_search
